name: cdm/event/common/Exposure
description: Represents the current mark to market value or IM calculation value of the trade portfolio as recorded by the principle (in base currency).

aggregateValue.description: Represents the aggregate value of the portfolio in base currency.

calculationDateTime.description: Indicates the date when the exposure is calculated if different from valuation date.

tradePortfolio.description: Represents a Portfolio that describes all the positions held at a given time, in various states which can be either traded, settled, etc., with lineage information to the previous state.

valuationDateTime.description: Indicates the valuation date of the exposure underlying the calculation.
